addBond(address,uint256).details: Allowed in Bonded, Unbonding, or Unbonded-with-residual status. Only operator or beneficiary.      NOTE: Adding bond while in Unbonding status does NOT cancel the pending unbond. The added tokens      increase the total amount but the unbondingAmount stays unchanged. After executeUnbond(), the      newly added tokens remain in the bond.

params.operator: The operator to add bond for

params.beneficiary: The pre-committed beneficiary address (locked at approval time)
params.bonder: The address to approve as a bonder
params.delegateKey: The pre-committed delegate key (locked at approval time)

params.amount: Amount of sUP to bond (must be >= minimumBond)
params.beneficiary: Address that receives sUP on unbond (immutable during active bond)
params.delegateKey: Validator's signing key for off-chain coordination

bondFor(address,uint256).details: beneficiary and delegateKey are read from the pre-committed approval

params.amount: Amount of sUP to bond (must be >= minimumBond)

params.paramKey: The parameter key to cancel (MINIMUM_BOND_KEY or UNBONDING_PERIOD_KEY)

params.operator: The operator whose unbond to cancel
The operator whose unbond to execute

returns._0: Array of actively bonded operator addresses

getBond(address).details: WARNING: Do not use record.status alone to determine active-bond status. Use isBonded() instead.

returns._0: The full BondForApproval struct (bonder, beneficiary, delegateKey)

params.key: The parameter key (MINIMUM_BOND_KEY, UNBONDING_PERIOD_KEY, or PARAMETER_TIMELOCK_KEY)

returns.effectiveTime: The timestamp when the change can be executed (0 if no pending change)
returns.value: The proposed value (0 if no pending change)

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

isBonded(address).details: Returns true if status == Bonded AND effective balance >= minimumBond

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

params.amount: Amount to unbond (partial: remaining must be >= minimumBond)

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

slash(address,uint256,address).details: Only callable by GOVERNOR_ROLE. Slash is proportional across bonded + unbonding portions.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.
